title: AEON Learn curriculum
description: A compiled, dependency-ordered curriculum (products/learn/curriculum.md). This schema validates the structural minimum only; the full 12-field module contract is normative in prose (LEARN-6 in products/learn/specification.md), so fixtures and partially compiled curricula still validate.

version.description: Curriculum version, bumped on recompilation; learner state references it via journey.curriculum_version.

language.description: Primary teaching language, as a BCP 47 tag or a natural-language name.

description.description: Short summary of the learning path.

modules.description: Modules in teaching order, sequenced by dependency structure rather than thematic grouping.

module.description: One curriculum module. The full contract carries twelve fields: id, title, learning_objective, prerequisites, core_concepts, evidence, counterposition, example, exercise, reflection, retrieval_question, estimated_duration. Additional properties are allowed because fixtures carry renderer- and subject-specific extras.

id.description: Stable module identifier, unique within the curriculum.

learning_objective.description: What the learner can do or explain after completing the module.

prerequisites.description: ids of modules that this module depends on. Empty for entry modules.

core_concepts.description: The concepts this module introduces or deepens.

evidence.description: Research grounding for the module: a summary or a list of source references or evidence entries.

counterposition.description: The strongest serious counterargument or competing interpretation the module engages with.

reflection.description: Reflection questions. Three is the norm per the canonical session anatomy; the count is prose-normative, not schema-forced.

retrieval_question.description: Recall question reaching back to earlier modules.

estimated_duration.description: Estimated learner time; integer minutes or a phrase such as "20 minutes".
